basic_details.short_information: Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026 notification has been released by Sainik School Chittorgarh on its official website, inviting applications for 6 Various Posts under Advertisement No. EN 17/27. This recruitment offers a great opportunity for eligible candidates seeking contractual government jobs in the education sector.

content_sections.heading: Sainik School Chittorgarh Recruitment 2026: Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: Appointment is purely on a contractual basis for one year, extendable to three years, with a one-month break after completion of every 11 months of service, as per Sainik Schools Cell, MoD, New Delhi guidelines. Services can be terminated at any point without assigning any reason; no extension of service will be entertained, including on medical or compassionate grounds. Individuals may be assigned secondary duties at the discretion of the Principal/Vice Principal/Administrative Officer, without extra remuneration, allowance, or rest. If any declaration or information furnished is found to be wrong or suppressed, candidature can be cancelled at any stage, or services terminated even after joining, without notice period, pay, or reason. Apart from the consolidated pay, no other allowances or pay will be paid. Being a residential school, individuals may be required to work beyond normal working hours without extra pay or allowances. No travelling allowance or medical allowance is admissible.
